title: 谁不是恐龙 · 素材
subtitle: 给对比页用的单体素材，不是一本书
style: children's picture book illustration, fine pen and ink lines with light washes, muted olive, brick red and warm grey

pages.scene: One single flying reptile gliding with both wings spread wide, seen from the side: each wing is a skin membrane held out by one very long finger bone, and it has a long pointed beak and a crest behind its head. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges.

One single sea reptile swimming, seen from the side: a smooth streamlined body with four paddle-shaped flippers, a long narrow snout and a large upright tail fin. Centred and filling most of the picture on a flat cream background of one single even colour, nothing else in the picture.

One single small bird perched, seen from the side facing right, its beak, folded wing and tail feathers clearly shaped. Centred and filling most of the picture on a flat cream background of one single even colour, nothing else in the picture.

One single woolly mammoth standing on four legs, seen from the side facing left, covered in long shaggy hair, with two long curved tusks and a raised domed head. Centred and filling most of the picture on a flat cream background of one single even colour, nothing else in the picture.

One single two-legged meat-eating dinosaur standing, seen from the side facing left, its whole body from snout to tail tip inside the picture. Centred and filling most of the picture on a flat cream background of one single even colour, nothing else in the picture.
